description: The plateau's mysteries become increasingly tied to time, identity and the explorers' own histories as Finn joins the group and Veronica's family legacy moves toward the unresolved fate of the Lost World itself.

s03e01.description: The exploding dirigible throws Challenger, Roxton and Marguerite into 1915 on the day of its original mission. To restore the timeline and return to the plateau, they must deliberately board the doomed airship while Veronica confronts Captain Askwith in the present.

s03e02.description: While searching for Malone, Marguerite is rescued by an elegant band of thieves whose leader claims he can get her off the plateau. Her friends soon discover the travelers are not entirely human and that Marguerite's apparent decision to join them may carry a different price.

s03e03.description: Roxton kills an animal in a sacred dinosaur burial ground and is judged by its guardian, Oseena. His punishment is to become prey in a hunt to the death, with Marguerite used as bait to make certain the hunter cannot simply walk away.

s03e04.description: Veronica becomes convinced that Malone is trapped in the spirit world, prompting an attempt to contact him. The séance risks releasing the vengeful warlord Saros instead, turning a rescue of one lost soul into a threat against everyone still alive.

s03e05.description: A mysterious knife transports Malone into visions of 1888 London and the Jack the Ripper murders. As familiar faces occupy disturbing roles in the past, Veronica and the others investigate a visitor whose interest in the same weapon may bring the killings onto the plateau.

s03e06.description: A dying messenger points the expedition toward Pierson Rice, a celebrated hunter Roxton once admired. They discover Rice ruling a native community and preparing to consolidate power through murder and marriage, forcing Roxton to reassess one of his old heroes.

s03e07.description: A hangman's noose throws Roxton into an alternate American West where his companions exist as strangers with different lives. Accused of a crime and facing a hostile sheriff, he must solve the logic of the strange world before its final showdown becomes permanent.

s03e08.description: Challenger's improved balloon crashes inside the caldera of an extinct volcano, trapping the group in a subterranean region. Repairing the craft requires scarce iron, and a local warrior's proposed supply route turns out to involve theft from an enemy with excellent reasons to object.

s03e09.description: A witch threatened by Challenger's science sends her apprentices after Roxton and Malone while confronting Challenger herself. His fascination with her abilities lowers his guard until sabotage turns the contest between magic and reason into a threat to the whole group.

s03e10.description: A poisoned dart sends Malone into memories of his first experience as a war correspondent during the First World War. Forced to relive a disastrous crossing of No Man's Land, he confronts the moment when an observer of battle had to become a participant.

s03e11.description: A meteor impact begins draining heat from the plateau and brings the explorers into contact with blue-skinned visitors adapted to extreme cold. Challenger realizes the falling temperature is not a natural disaster but the opening stage of an invasion.

s03e12.description: After one narrow escape too many, Roxton is confronted by Death in human form and pulled into a game for his soul. Each round puts his friends at risk, forcing him to choose between self-preservation and the people whose lives are being used as stakes.

s03e13.description: Veronica follows mysterious piano music into a German village that seems to exist outside normal time. The composer who claims to have written for her becomes increasingly persuasive just as Challenger concludes that returning with him could make Veronica disappear from their world.

s03e14.description: An attacker leaves Veronica with a symbol that Marguerite immediately recognizes and conceals. The incident forces Marguerite to reveal why she really financed the Challenger expedition and how secrets from her past are connected to the plateau.

s03e15.description: Challenger's attempt to use the plateau's energy lines as a route back to London instead sends part of the group into a post-apocalyptic future. There they meet Finn and discover that the Lost World has become one of the few surviving places on Earth.

s03e16.description: A lost archaeological party opens an urn said to contain a demon, after which its members turn on one another. Roxton and Marguerite arrive among the survivors and face a problem that makes every accusation of possession equally plausible.

s03e17.description: Three demons replace Challenger, Roxton and Marguerite after an encounter with a gateway to another reality. Finn has only a short time to expose the impostors and recover her friends before the substitutions become permanent.

s03e18.description: Challenger tests an experimental food substitute on himself and becomes dangerously obsessed when the results diverge from his laboratory trials. Hallucinations of his younger self and his wife accompany a physical collapse that leaves his friends racing to undo the experiment.

s03e19.description: The wreck of a First World War aircraft and a cache of stolen iridium connect Challenger and Marguerite to the same wartime mystery. Separate memories of MI5 interrogations begin revealing that their presence on the plateau may owe less to coincidence than either believed.

s03e20.description: Veronica's mother's pendant triggers memories of the final days before her parents disappeared. The new version of those events contradicts what she has always believed and reveals that the pendant is tied to a larger destiny still approaching.

s03e21.description: An explosion traps Roxton and Marguerite underground while leaving Challenger with no memory of who he is or whom he needs to save. At the Treehouse, Veronica and Finn uncover another piece of Veronica's childhood as the trapped pair confront what they mean to each other.

s03e22.description: Reality begins collapsing around the plateau, throwing its inhabitants into fragments of different eras while a massive storm approaches. Veronica learns that her mother's pendant, the Trion, may make her the plateau's Protector and force a choice between saving the Lost World and destroying it.
